title: MedHarnessBench: A Unified Benchmark for Healthcare Agent Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.15714v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Healthcare agents must transform longitudinal clinical evidence into reliable actions through heterogeneous tools and stateful workflows, conditions under which model-centric systems may lose context, misuse tools, fail to verify consequential transitions, or cross authorization boundaries. Existing medical-agent benchmarks primarily emphasize terminal task outcomes, making it difficult to determine whether execution failures arise from the agent model, the runtime harness, or their interaction. We present the Medical Harness Protocol, an outcome-preserving framework that independently evaluates seven healthcare-specific process dimensions: Care Action Fulfillment, Clinical Resource Competence, Patient-Evidence Alignment, Clinical Workflow Continuity, Clinical Auditability, Closed-Loop Verification, and Clinical Conduct Boundaries. translated_title: MedHarnessBench：一个用于医疗保健智能体评估的统一基准
translated_abstract: 医疗智能体必须通过异构工具和有状态的工作流，将纵向临床证据转化为可靠的行动；在这种条件下，以模型为中心的系统可能出现上下文丢失、工具误用、未能验证关键状态转换或越过授权边界等问题。现有的医疗智能体基准主要强调终端任务结果，因此难以判断执行失败究竟源于智能体模型、运行时框架，还是二者的交互作用。我们提出了医疗Harness协议，这是一个在保持结果不变的前提下，可独立评估七个医疗特定过程维度的框架：护理行动履行、临床资源胜任力、患者-证据对齐、临床工作流连续性、临床可审计性、闭环验证以及临床行为边界。此外，规范化的干预踪迹还能进一步追踪运行时支持是否可用、是否被激活、是否被交付……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出MedHarnessBench及医疗Harness协议，这是一个保持结果不变的统一评估框架，可独立评估七个医疗过程维度（如护理行动履行、临床可审计性、闭环验证等），从而区分医疗智能体的执行失败究竟源于模型本身、运行时框架还是二者的交互。
en_tdlr: MedHarnessBench introduces the Medical Harness Protocol, an outcome-preserving unified benchmark that independently evaluates seven healthcare-specific process dimensions to determine whether medical agent execution failures arise from the agent model, the runtime harness, or their interaction.
